rating.comments: The student gave single-step answers with no justification, such as "1. There are around 1000 students." and "2. 1l.", and later a bare "9". They asked a content question of their own: "¿Cuántas pulsaciones de teclas se necesitan para escribir números del 1 al 1000?". The pasted opinion question was ignored, and the water-task answers only supply values the tutor requested, so knowledge building stays at echo level. Effort is rated 3 because the complete sentence attempts are task-focused but show little follow-through.
